name: FS2 Supply Company
old_description: Sat 9-5, Sun 11-4. 500 Market Street Suite 108 in the Santa Fe Railyard.
about:
FS2 Supply Company operates a retail store at 500 Market Street Suite 108 in the Santa Fe Railyard, Santa Fe, New Mexico. The business is family-owned, though the founding year and founders’ names are not disclosed. It began as a local shop offering New Mexico-themed apparel and gifts.

The company sells a range of branded apparel including tees, headgear, outerwear, merchandise, and kids’ lines under the “Familia” label. Each garment carries a signature FS2 tag sewn in New Mexico, indicating a final assembly step performed locally. The store functions as a one-stop shop for local apparel, with no disclosed facility size, headcount, or production volumes.

The customer base consists of residents and visitors seeking New Mexico pride merchandise, as reflected in testimonials from local families. The company does not list specific industrial clients or sectors beyond direct-to-consumer retail.

FS2 emphasizes a personal, family-centered approach, stating that any business that isn’t personal isn’t worth building. The locally sewn signature tags and the focus on family stories are presented as key differentiators.
built_on: Signature tags sewn in New Mexico
type_evidence: FS2, a family owned business, is the best 'one stop shop' to find all your favorite local apparel!
